z-m-02-03.title: Uma ngamunye ethola inani elifanayo lamasitikha engeziwe, ubani onamangaki engeziwe?

z-m-02-03.material: UJihu noHayun baqoqa amasitikha. Funda indaba engezansi isinyathelo ngesinyathelo futhi usho lokho okucabangayo.
z-m-02-03.thinking.0: Ukunquma ukuthi uhlulela kanjani uma ungazazi izinombolo
z-m-02-03.thinking.2: Ukusebenza ukuthi isiphetho siyashintsha yini uma umbandela ushintsha

z-m-02-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uqagele ukuthi njengoba inani elitholiwe lifana, umehluko nawo uzohlala unjalo. Kuyiqagelo elifanele ukuhlolwa ngezinombolo.

z-m-02-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Lena umcabango wokuthi uGaon usondele wonke umehluko wamasitikha angu-3 kaSeou futhi uno-1 ngaphezulu.

z-m-02-03.s.s2.hint.1: Bala wena ukuthi kwenzekani enomboloni kaHayun nasemehlukweni uma uHayun kuphela enikezwa u-2.

z-m-02-01.title: Amapensela amabili esingawabekanga eceleni komunye: liliphi elide?
z-m-02-01.topic: Ukuxhumanisa ukuqhathanisa kobude nokwahlulela ukuthi ulwazi lwanele yini
z-m-02-01.goal: Hlukanisa ukuthi ungaxhumanisa nini imiphumela yokuqhathanisa onayo kakade nokuthi udinga nini ukuqhathanisa okwengeziwe, bese usho ukuthi yini enye okufanele iqhathaniswe ukuze kunqunywe.
z-m-02-01.material: Kunamapensela amane amasha etafuleni leqembu. Amathegi amagama angu-가, 나, 다, no-라. Ukuqhathanisa ubude, wonke amapensela alungiswa aqondiswe futhi alandelana ngohlangothi olulodwa olufanayo. Kuze kube manje, kwenziwe ukuqhathanisa okubili kuphela eceleni komunye. Okokuqala, 가 mude kuno-나. Okwesibili, 나 mude kuno-다. 가 no-다 abazange babekwe eceleni komunye, futhi 라 akakabekwa eceleni kwanoma yiliphi ipensela.
z-m-02-01.thinking.0: Ukuxhumanisa ukuqhathanisa osuvele ukwazi ukuze ufinyelele esiphethweni esisha
z-m-02-01.prereq.0: Ukuqhathanisa 'ende/ifushane' ngokubeka izinto ezimbili ziphelele eziphelweni (izinga leBanga 1)
z-m-02-01.s.s1.prompt: 가 no-다 abazange babekwe eceleni komunye. Yimuphi phakathi kwamapensela amabili esingasho ukuthi mude?
z-m-02-01.s.s1.hint.0: Layina 가, 나, 다 kusukela kokude kakhulu kuya kokufushane bese ububhala phansi.
z-m-02-01.s.s1.o.a: Asikwazi ukwazi okwamanje. Kumele sibabeke eceleni komunye
z-m-02-01.s.s1.r.a: Kuyiqiniso ukuthi ukuzama ngqo kunikeza impendulo eqinisekile. Kodwa ngaphambi kokusho "asikwazi ukwazi okwamanje", bheka ukuthi ungaxhumanisa yini ukuqhathanisa okubili osuvele ukwazi.
z-m-02-01.s.s1.o.b: 다 mude. 다 yipensela lokugcina elavela
z-m-02-01.s.s1.r.b: Ukulandelana amapensela avela ngakho endabeni akunaluhlobo nobude. Kuphela ukuqhathanisa okusho ukuthi yiliphi ipensela elide kubalwa njengobufakazi.
z-m-02-01.s.s1.r.c: Lokhu kuxhumanise ukuqhathanisa okubili: 가 mude kuno-나, futhi 나 mude kuno-다.
z-m-02-01.s.s1.o.d: Bafana ngobude. Ngoba asibabekanga eceleni komunye
z-m-02-01.s.s1.r.d: Ukungabekwa eceleni komunye akuyona ubufakazi bokuthi ubude buyafana. Ukuthi bayafana noma bayahluka kumele kusho kusukela emiphumeleni yokuqhathanisa.
z-m-02-01.s.s1.explain: Ga mude kuno-Na, futhi Na mude kuno-Da. Behlelwe kusukela kokude kakhulu, Ga uza kuqala, bese Na, bese Da. Ngakho Ga mude kuno-Da. Ungahlola ngokuzama ngqo, kodwa noma ngaphambi kokuzama, ungathola ngokuxhumanisa ukuqhathanisa osuvele ukwazi.
z-m-02-01.s.s2.prompt: Ulwazi olusha: sibeke 다 no-라 eceleni komunye, futhi 라 wayemude kuno-다. Khona yimuphi omude, 가 noma 라?
z-m-02-01.s.s2.hint.0: Layina 가, 나, 다, 라 kusukela kokude kakhulu kuya kokufushane. Dweba imigqa emibili noma ngaphezulu engenzeka.
z-m-02-01.s.s2.hint.1: Hambisa indawo ka-라 ubheke ukuthi ukuqhathanisa okubili okwaziwayo nokuqhathanisa okusha konke kugcinwa.

z-m-02-01.s.s2.r.a: Ukuba ipensela lokuqala ukuvela akusona isizathu ngobude. Udinga ukubheka ukuthi kukhona yini ukuqhathanisa okuxhuma 가 no-라.
z-m-02-01.s.s2.o.b: Asazi okwamanje. Akukho kuqhathanisa okuxhuma 가 no-라
z-m-02-01.s.s2.o.c: Asikwazi ukusho. Kumele sibeke 가 no-다 eceleni komunye futhi kuqala
z-m-02-01.s.s2.r.c: Sekunqunyiwe kakade ukuthi 가 mude kuno-다. Okungakanqunywa manje kungu-가 no-라.
z-m-02-01.s.s2.o.d: 라 mude. Ngoba kungukuqhathanisa esikufunde ekugcineni
z-m-02-01.s.s2.r.d: Awukwazi ukusho ukuthi mude ngoba kungukuqhathanisa esikufunde kamuva. Sifunde kuphela ukuthi 라 mude kuno-다.

z-m-02-01.s.s3.prompt: Yimaphi amapensela amabili ongawabeka eceleni komunye ukuze uthole ukuthi 라 mude kuno-가 yini? Bhala indlela eyodwa, futhi ubhale nokuthi yimuphi umphumela ongakwazisa.
z-m-02-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala uhlole ukuthi ukuqhathanisa okwaziwayo kuxhuma ngqo 가 no-라 yini.
z-m-02-01.s.s3.hint.1: Nquma ukubeka 라 eceleni kwelilodwa lika-가, 나, 다, bese ucabanga ngokwehlukana ukuthi 라 mude nini nokuthi mufushane nini.
z-m-02-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Uma ubeka amapensela amabili engiwakhethile eceleni komunye, kunqunyiwe ukuthi yimuphi omude phakathi kuka-가 no-라?

z-m-02-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingabe uqaphele, njengasempendulweni yesibonelo 2, ukuthi kukhona nendlela yokwengeza isimo, ngokuthi 'singazi kuphela uma umphumela unjena'?
z-m-02-01.s.s3.model.0: Beka 라 no-가 eceleni komunye. Uma uqhathanisa ubude bamapensela amabili ngqo, ungasho ngokushesha ukuthi yimuphi omude.
z-m-02-01.s.s3.model.1: Beka 라 eceleni kuka-나. Uma 라 mufushane kuno-나, 가 mude kuno-나, ngakho ungazi ukuthi 가 mude. Uma 라 mude kuno-나, asisazi.
z-m-02-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Le mpendulo isho nokuthi, kuye ngomphumela, kungenzeka kunqunywe noma singazi.
